product_one_liner.value: Vectary is an online design platform for designers and creative/product teams to develop concepts with AI and create interactive 3D presentations and augmented-reality experiences.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage describes its platform and the intended creative/design users.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists Free, Starter, Team, and Business plans.

named_customers.notes: Vectary's agency page describes KTM's use of configurators; Vectary's case-study article identifies Hyundai.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn currently reports 18 employees; the company size range is 11–50, which overlaps two permitted bands. The available direct count of 18 supports 11–20.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists Vectary's headquarters as Redwood City, California, United States.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index is oriented toward product, design workflows, tutorials, and marketing. The available workflow posts do not establish at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public Vectary documentation/help site provides multiple articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Wellfound says Vectary has not added any jobs; Built In reports no discoverable jobs. No current AI/ML/data-science posting was found.

model_provider.notes: The product documentation describes AI/model functionality, but the available public docs and security/privacy materials did not identify a specific AI model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Vectary's security page names SOC 2 certification and states compliance with ISO 27001 and GDPR. CCPA is also stated there but is not one of the requested certification categories.

last_funding.notes: Vectary announced a $7.3 million round on October 20, 2020; the contemporaneous FinSMEs report describes it as seed funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identifiable round is the October 2020 $7.3 million round, well before the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Vectary's job listings state that no jobs are available/discoverable; no current SDR, BDR, sales representative, business development representative, or account executive posting was found.

launched_6mo.notes: Vectary's Instagram launch announcement for Vectary Canvas is dated approximately six months before the run date; a company LinkedIn post also describes Vectary Canvas AI material-comparison functionality at about six months.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated evidence of a C-level or VP-level join/departure in the 12-month window was found, but a sufficiently complete, current team page or People listing was not available to support a negative answer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Vectary's public integrations and documentation pages describe product integrations/APIs but do not name a CRM or sales/marketing platform.
